name: Gungeon Proper
description: The first floor of the Gungeon. Teaches the basics — modest enemies, generous loot.

name: Gungeon Proper (Lower)
description: Second floor. Tougher enemies, first real threat — Bullet King roams here.

name: Oubliette
description: Secret floor. Sewer depths below the Gungeon's first floors — poison pits and the Blobulord.

name: Abbey of the True Gun
description: Secret floor — a hidden monastery. The Old King's ghost guards ancient secrets.

name: Black Powder Mine
description: Third floor. A collapsing mine overrun with explosives and the Cannonballer's crew.

name: Hollow
description: Fourth floor. A frozen void filled with the Gungeon's undead inhabitants.

name: R&G Dept.
description: Secret floor. The Gungeon's research wing — experimental tech and the Rat King himself.

name: Forge
description: Fifth floor. The final forge where the Gungeon's power is made — lava, elite foes, the High Dragun.

name: Bullet Hell
description: The deepest floor. Pure bullet hell — only the strongest survive to the Lich.
